name: Word magnets
summary: Magnetic poetry on a drawn fridge door: a pile of word magnets pulled from the chat's own words, tap magnets to build your line, stick it and it snaps onto the door next to your face; one line each, and the door becomes the group's poem.
useWhen: write a poem about this apartment, one line each
fridge magnet poetry but with our inside jokes
something cute for the gc on a slow night
make a group poem for maya's birthday card
everyone add a line about the semester
dontUseWhen: a long message or a card with paragraphs (use a card tool)
a word game with points (use letter-sprint or word-bomb)

words.description: Up to 36 single words, mostly from the chat's own jokes and places, plus small glue words (the, is, and, my)

lines.description: Lines already on the door: who and their words, each taken from the word list
